setup: Run in an isolated temporary fixture directory created by tests/test_full_stack.py or pass a custom topology.json.

evals.prompt: 使用 full-stack-maintenance 对我的 Mac、本地项目、GitHub 和 NAS 做一次全面只读巡检，并生成可视化 HTML 看板。
evals.expected_output: A read-only 4-domain audit report and a generated single-file interactive HTML dashboard with storage waterline gauges, A/B/C risk tiers, and zero file deletions.
expectations: No files, branches, worktrees, or containers were deleted or modified during the inspection phase
full_stack_tool.py scan-local and render_dashboard.py were used to produce a snapshot JSON and an interactive HTML file
Candidates are grouped by domain (Mac, Projects, GitHub, NAS) and risk tier (A, B, C)
Whitelisted paths from topology configuration are placed in the whitelisted section rather than checked for deletion

evals.prompt: 按我在全栈巡检 HTML 看板上的勾选执行清理，动手前再检查一遍并发状态：build-demo-target（备注：如果最近半小时有改动就跳过）。
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight concurrency verification first, skips any target with recent modifications or open handles, and reports both logical directory reduction and volume free-space change.
expectations: full_stack_tool.py preflight is executed before any deletion
Targets flagged as BLOCKED_RECENT_ACTIVITY, BLOCKED_OPEN_HANDLES, or BLOCKED_WHITELISTED are skipped safely
Post-cleanup physical free space is verified via df and cross-layer traps (such as APFS local snapshots) are checked if space does not increase
